persona: Windows server admin who looks after the VMware estate part time
resumeText:
Rohit Deshpande | Pune | rohit.deshpande@example.com

SUMMARY
Wintel administrator with 5 years in data-centre operations.

EXPERIENCE
Server Administrator, Sahyadri Infotech Services, Pune (2021 - present)
- Manage 180 Windows Server 2016 and 2019 virtual machines for a manufacturing client.
- Built and patched 12 ESXi hosts in vCenter and configured HA and DRS on two clusters.
- Created port groups and VLAN tags on distributed switches with the network team.
- Raise change requests and close incidents in ServiceNow under ITIL processes.
- Run nightly Veeam backup jobs and tested VM restores every quarter.

Junior System Administrator, Deccan Data Systems, Pune (2019 - 2021)
- Handled Active Directory users, DNS and DHCP on Windows Server 2012 R2.
- Extended datastores by adding LUNs from the Dell Unity array with the storage team.

SKILLS
VMware vSphere, Windows Server, PowerShell, Veeam, ServiceNow

EDUCATION
BE Computer Engineering, Pune University, 2019
